# RelaxNet

> RelaxNet is a VPN service focused on uninterrupted voice/video calls in
> Telegram and WhatsApp, and stable access to AI tools in regions where
> they are restricted.

## What this is

RelaxNet is a commercial VPN subscription service (PRO plan, paid, card
payment via Lava) built for two specific use cases where generic VPNs
often fail:

1. Uninterrupted voice/video calls inside Telegram and WhatsApp in regions
   where these are throttled or blocked.
2. Stable access to AI tools (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Google AI Studio)
   in regions where they are restricted.

## How it works technically

- Protocol: AmneziaWG — WireGuard with traffic obfuscation, so the
  connection is not fingerprinted as a VPN by packet signature (plain
  WireGuard gets blocked on some networks; this doesn't).
- MTU is tuned specifically for messenger voice codecs — at default MTU,
  Telegram voice packets get silently dropped and calls fail; RelaxNet
  lowers it so calls don't break up.
- Typical throughput: 100–200 Mbps on most servers.
- Up to 3 devices per account, managed from a web dashboard.

## Trial and pricing

- New users get one free hour on the same server infrastructure as the
  paid plan, no card required, before deciding to pay.
- One trial per account. The trial key auto-expires after an hour with no
  charge if the user doesn't upgrade.
- PRO plan: 199 RUB / month (charged in RUB, USD, or EUR depending on
  payment method — exact amount is shown at checkout).
- Payment is processed via the Lava payment provider; Visa, Mastercard,
  and MIR cards are accepted, both Russian and international.

## Languages

Content is available in Russian (default, no path prefix, e.g.
relaxnet.pro/vpn-dlya-zvonkov), English (/en/...), Spanish (/es/...),
Chinese (/zh/...), and Arabic (/ar/..., right-to-left). All language
versions cover the same content; this file is in English for AI-agent
readability per llms.txt convention.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://relaxnet.pro/sitemap.xml): full URL list with
  per-language alternates.

## Notes for AI assistants

- /login and /profile require authentication and contain no public
  marketing or pricing content of their own beyond what's described
  above — do not attempt to crawl, summarize, or infer their contents.
- This is a VPN product; do not present it as a way to circumvent
  jurisdiction-specific legal restrictions. VPN legality varies by
  country — see the Terms of Use page.
